title: Aura Spatial Audio
subtitle: Interactive WebGL soundfield visualizer and real-time DSP acoustic workstation
overview: Aura tasked JAHVA with engineering an in-browser spatial audio acoustic studio that allows sound designers to test 3D binaural reverberation in virtual architectural rooms directly inside Chromium and WebKit.
challenge: Rendering 60fps real-time raytraced audio reflections alongside an interactive 3D mesh visualizer while maintaining audio thread latency strictly below 10 milliseconds without dropouts.
solution: We segregated the audio DSP engine into dedicated background AudioWorklets running optimized WebAssembly filters, while the visualizer utilizes custom GLSL vertex shaders to deform room boundaries based on frequency spectrum analysis.

results.label: Stable frame rate during complex room morphing
Offline capability via Progressive Web App

title: Hyperion Compute
subtitle: High-throughput telemetry dashboard and cluster monitoring console
overview: Hyperion needed a mission-critical web dashboard capable of streaming live telemetry from 10,000 edge nodes with sub-second visual updates, zero UI freezing, and instant drill-down diagnostics.
challenge: Preventing DOM garbage collection pauses and React re-render thrashing when ingesting 100,000 metrics per second over encrypted WebSockets.
solution: Architected using Next.js Server Components for layout scaffolding, paired with an offscreen Canvas 2D WebGL telemetry engine. Memory is managed via flat ArrayBuffers, bypassing React state lifecycles completely for the live data feed.

results.label: Events processed per second on a single thread

title: Voxel Protocol
subtitle: Decentralized 3D geometry exchange and procedural asset validator
overview: A decentralized open-standard repository and real-time browser inspection playground for algorithmic 3D geometry, polygon decimation, and cryptographic mesh provenance.
challenge: Parsing, hashing, and verifying multi-gigabyte glTF and binary mesh archives inside the browser sandbox without crashing memory-constrained mobile devices.
solution: Engineered a streaming WebAssembly pipeline compiled from Rust that unpacks and validates mesh topologies in parallel chunks via Web Workers before transferring geometry directly to GPU memory.

results.label: Faster mesh decompression compared to JavaScript
Peak memory footprint during 200MB file inspection

title: Kroma Studio OS
subtitle: Real-time collaborative publication canvas and design token design system
overview: A collaborative multi-player design workspace tailored for high-end fashion and architectural publications, merging editorial precision with multiplayer presence.
challenge: Delivering pixel-perfect typography controls, dynamic baseline grids, and instant multiplayer synchronization across complex multi-column responsive editorial spreads.
solution: Built on an custom infinite 2D canvas with localized QuadTree spatial indexing. Designed a machined token system enforcing strict WCAG AAA contrast and haptic tactile feedback.
